_doc: Realms of Africa and the Americas born between 1379 and 1444, or later, that the 1444 map shows: listed from the start and asleep until they form (SETUP-080, X-25). capital is a [lon, lat] point and home a list of owner-rule selectors, which the merge step resolves to provinces of the 1378 map. From start-date/research/africa-americas.md and research/decisions.md; built by tools/domain-data/start-1378-africa-americas.py from the 1444 files.

realms.name: Adal Sultanate
realms.why: The Walashma heirs refound Ifat's state in the east after Sa'ad ad-Din II falls at Zeila.

realms.name: Kingdom of Kongo
realms.why: Lukeni lua Nimi takes the Mbanza Kongo area with Mbata's alliance (traditional date).

realms.name: Mutapa
realms.why: Mutota moves north from Great Zimbabwe and conquers the Dande (traditional).

realms.name: Torwa
realms.why: Khami rises in the south-west as Great Zimbabwe fades (c.1400-1450, disputed).

realms.name: Ajuran
realms.why: An inland Shabelle power; it holds Mogadishu's hinterland only in the 15th century (low confidence).

realms.name: Kaffa
realms.why: The Minjo dynasty founds Kaffa among the Gonga chiefdoms (traditional).

realms.name: Aïr Sultanate
realms.why: The Aïr confederations found a sultanate; its seat moves to Agadez c.1430.

realms.name: Tuareg of the Niger bend
realms.why: Akil's Tuareg take Timbuktu from a weakened Mali.

realms.name: Fulbe of Masina
realms.why: Fulbe ardos settle Masina in the inland delta.

realms.name: Lordship of the Canary Islands
realms.why: Béthencourt and Gadifer conquer Lanzarote and Fuerteventura for Castile (1402-05).

realms.name: Bougie
realms.why: A Hafsid prince holds Bougie against Tunis after Abu Faris dies (could be an event instead).

realms.name: Debdou
realms.why: The Banu Urtajjen make Debdou a lordship of their own (could be an event instead).

realms.name: Hintata of Marrakesh
realms.why: The Hintata take Marrakesh as Marinid rule in the south collapses (no firm date).

realms.name: Loango
realms.why: The Maloango unite the Vili polities of the coast (late 14th-15th c., disputed).

realms.name: Buganda
realms.why: Great Lakes kingdom of tradition; dating is oral, the research leans to later than 1378.

realms.name: Ankole
realms.why: Hinda dynasty, usually placed after the Chwezi.

realms.name: Karagwe
realms.why: Hinda dynasty, usually placed after the Chwezi.

realms.name: Rwanda
realms.why: Nyiginya dating is disputed (15th-17th c.).

realms.name: Mandara
realms.why: Probably not yet a kingdom; Fra Mauro names it c.1450.

realms.name: Coosa
realms.why: The Coosa paramountcy at Little Egypt forms after Etowah's fall (c.1400-1500, disputed).

realms.name: Cherokee
realms.why: The Cherokee coalesce as a nation long after 1444; Mississippian chiefdoms hold the land (decision 6).

realms.name: Creek
realms.why: The Creek Confederacy coalesces long after 1444; Mississippian chiefdoms hold the land (decision 6).
